notes.title: Info About Next Update
notes.notes:
Haven't been available much to communicate becuase of family & housing stuff i've had to work on

first just to clear up some potential confusion:

- The Hades style prototype is for a sequel coming out after this game's 1.0. The prototype is extremely outdated though. Spellbook 1 will remain an auto-shooting game.

- The update that changed the knockback system and adds the 2nd character has actually been out for a few months, but I didn't draw attention to the launch of it. That update is not the "1.0" update.

here are some of the things coming in the next update:

 Replaced Spellbook system, books now have unique "Signature Spells" that cost Mana. Regular spells still do not cost Mana, only Signature Spells.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/994a971d70a80a5b00c76bf9576c11ffb3d6c889.png
 Dual book upgrade can be found during runs allowing you to run 2 books & Signature Spells at the same time.
 New Auto-attacking dual-wielding weapon system. Attacks generate Mana, and can be Charged. You can swap between 2 equipped weapons instantly with a button press.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/2418dfd16993cde4a84356ea620bd4502af990f4.png
 New Weapon Fusion system to customize and extend their combos. All weapons can have their attacks replaced with those of any other weapon, letting you combine their unique abilities with any moveset you want. You can also slot Instant Attacks in between your regular combo attacks. These often come with bonuses like applying status effects on hit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/dabf22773f437d21e8494f699b2acfe6a4b39937.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/d6d4c6041713c596ebeb9f6dfd9ad785c9dd87f5.png
 New "Augments" system: Lets you socket upgrades into your spells and abilities to add effects. Spells begin with no Augments, but each Ability comes with 1 starter Augment. As you equip new Augments in runs you will also unlock them to use as your starting augment as well, offering lots of horizontal progression.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/cb7f44d2bfa0e660157df605f0e73e87e9d9cc77.png
 New Level Up System: The character you aren't playing as brings you reward portals of various types. That character can also be customized each run with utility upgrades.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/7fa37a534b6fccd412472404755f660557fe4289.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/54720d3849da15e1a7ac15c193a03802b8fdb55e.png
 New Battle Modifiers System: After you level up you are given a choice between a few different portals to continue through. Some of them will add additional risk/reward effects onto combat, letting you scale the intensity to your liking.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/ee96bae1f1ab534ad4791c1a7aaf1b5924cd1c9f.png
 New Wall Slam system: Damages and staggers enemies when you bounce them off walls and objects with Knockback. (Stagger is also new)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/b5bf481f9c5a7d972f1adeff38931990ac23edf8.png
 New "Devour" system: Strong enemies are crystallized on death. Devour their corpse within 13 seconds to make the crystals explode. The crystals are also objects that can block or Wall Slam enemies. Devour is considered an Ability, so it can be socketed with Augments.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/8d57855cc096376321570cede51299bbda43934e.png
 New "Shapeshift" System: Hold the dash button to shapeshift into Astral Fox Jeanne, draining Mana to greatly reduce your hitbox size. Shapeshifting also happens while you are Dashing, but regular dashes no longer cost Mana. The Mana drain only begins if you continue Shapeshifting after the Dash ends. Shapeshifting is an Ability that can be socketed with Augments.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/f6aa5df0506397c98a8cada7785ba8fb861e4e5d.png

Runs in this new system can be far more different than they can now, even without taking build archetypes into consideration. You can have runs focused entirely on weapons, on basic spells, on signature spells, focusing on any of your abilities, or mixing and matching any of them freely. Then within all of that, you also have archetypes like building into various status effects, elemental effects, and so on.

The previous version of the game is nothing compared to what this will be.

plus a lot more. i'llalso be replacing some existing parts of the game that are bad.

The new update also has a lot of improvements to fundamentals like:

 New tooltip system that displays info about your stats, detailed info on attacks & spells, and also displays a box of all upgrades you have that share the same tooltip. You can press the "View Embedded Tooltips" button to dig into these tooltips and view the tooltips of the upgrades that are being displayed inside the original tooltip.
 New text system that shows before & after info about stat changes on upgrades.
 Good controller support (i now play mainly on controller)
 Fully rebindable controls
 Overhauled aiming. On controller, simply aim with the Right Stick to instantly take control with manual aim, then let go of the stick again to immediately switch back to autoaim. On keyboard and mouse, hold or toggle the "Aim With Mouse" button to seamlessly switch between automatic and manual aiming.
 New camera and lock-on systems
 Redesigned every UI in the game
 Improved fonts and colors
 Expanded options menu
 New Stats & Stat reworks (especially Energy Shield)
 A bunch of new music by artists like Novander, including existing songs like LOTUS and VICIOUS and new original tracks created for the game.

... and more!

notes.title: NEW Features & BIG Balance Changes! [July 17]
notes.notes:
NEW Features & BIG Balance Changes!

New Permanent Upgrades / Enemy Spawn Change
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/656103a203c45910ae5c4f9c9632e22227d50feb.png
The Expel mechanic changes how you interact with demon spawns. Instead of taking a hit because a demon spawned too close to you, now you will be rewarded with bonus experience.

Permanent Upgrade: Expulsion
This upgrade causes demons to be Expelled when you touch their spawn notification, teleporting them away and dropping an Experience gem.

 Strong enemies now have larger and differently colored spawn notifications.
 You can now also purchase two points of +13% Demon Spawn Warning Duration in the upgrades menu.
 Astrid's Time Dilation passive now grants +50% Demon Spawn Warning Duration
 Spawn notifications now have a different animation instead of flashing.
You might want to turn off Damage Numbers if you are focusing on Expel a lot, to make it easier to see.

Ultimatum
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/90e695d8dbae426d072ac394b73e66b27c8290d6.png
You can now earn greater rewards using the Ultimatum system. Increasing the Ultimatum amount at a Corrupted Shrine will Spawn another shrine with increased rewards and difficulty, but enemy damage is permanently multiplied by +7% and yours by -7%.

Each step in an Ultimatum is harder & longer than the previous, and new Corrupted Shrines that spawn during it will become a part of your current Ultimatum. The Ultimatum ends when you choose an Arcane Upgrade.

Ultimatums will reward you with Charms, Demons, Astral Flowers, and Upgrade Chests, as well as a large amount of recovery orbs. The rewards are weighted towards Charms and Demon Chests.

Illegal Spell Selection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/4a719f484d5a2946d1ea57bb7b68b763aa0e2e40.png
You can now choose what spell you want to replace when taking an Illegal Spell at the Smuggler's Shrine.

Treasure Upgrade Auto-Confirm
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/faf3af2a22a5e4528f74314357724c33d7b872da.png
You can now enable an option that automatically skips treasure chest upgrade interfaces. A notification will be shown below your spells instead.

Rampage
Rampage is a new effect that grants +1.3% damage and +0.7% Movement Speed per stack (Max: 100). Drains rapidly if you haven't gained any Rampage recently.

The time it takes before Rampage begins draining is extended if you gain multiple stacks at once.

Changes & Fixes
 De-Yandere'd a bunch of the stat calculation code.
 Damage values over 1 million on stat displays are now shortened like "584.23m".
 More spell info is now shown on the pause screen.
 The Demon Summoning screen has been reorganized.
 The description for spell ugprades above level 10 has been changed to "Base Damage +10%" instead of "Spell Damage Multiplier +10%". This is only a text change, the mechanic itself has not been changed.
 Breaking the spell limit with Overlevel now shows the over-limit spell on the HUD.
 The Overlevel button now displays the Overlevel tooltip.
 Fixed an issue where Vella would only be unlocked if the spell you had 4 copies of had one of its copies in the first spell slot.
 Fixed an issue where Time Splicer's damage bonus was only applying in increments of 100%.
 Fixed an issue where Elite demon armor scaling was not working properly.
 Fixed an issue where Goblin's demon equip bonuses were not being applied.
 Fixed an issue where spawn notifications could spawn very far offscreen.
 Fixed an issue where Sigma Stance's description said 33% instead of 30% (this is only a text change, the effect itself has not been changed).
 Fixed an issue where Corrupted Shrines would sometimes not display the required amount of kills.


New In-Run Upgrades
Illegal: Unencumbered Rage
 The inverse of your Armor is also applied to: Max Rampage.
Illegal: Mana Storm
 Each Rampage stack also grants: Mana Recharge Speed +0.7%.

Aura & Effect Changes
Mending
 Now has "+1.3% HP Regenerated per second" instead of "Regeneration +1.0".
Bloodletting
 Now has "+1.3% HP Regenerated per second" instead of "Regeneration +1.0".
Samsara
 Now has Max HP +13% instead of Max HP -13%.
 Mutation: Life In Death now also has "For each used and remaining Revive: Max HP +13."
Nightshade
 Now has "Critical Multiplier +25%" instead of "Critical Chance +7%".
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Tailwind
 Mutation: Rat Race now also has "When you Expel a demon, reset the duration of all demon spawn warnings."
Revengeance
 Now has "When you Expel a Demon: Trigger Revengeance." instead of "Revengeance also triggers when you Dodge.
 Now also has "When you trigger Revengeance: Gain 1 Rampage.
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Velocity
 Mutation: Fission now also has "When you break an enemy projectile: Rampage Gained: +7".
Deathbound
 Now has "Demon Spawn Notification Rate +7%" instead of "Enemy Damage +7%".
Deadly Aim
 Mutation's "Critical Chance added as Base Damage" increased from 10% to 13%.
Acrobatics
 Mutation: Silent Assassin now Expels demons instead of killing them.
 Mutation: Silent Assassin's 7% HP reduction against elites that you dodge now only activates while Dashing.
 Unbinding cap reduced from 2 to 1. This Aura was contributing too much towards reaching the Dodge cap, but the individual levels do not need to be reduced in power. This makes room for more of this stat in other places.
Fortification
 Unbinding cap reduced from 2 to 1. This Aura was contributing too much towards reaching the Damage Reduction cap, but the individual levels do not need to be reduced in power. This makes room for more of this stat in other places.
Cybernetics
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Juggernaut
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Brutality
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Shrine Maiden
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Volition
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Demon Feast
 Unbinding cap increased from 7 to 9. 
Illegal: Wide Load
 Now has "Regeneration Multiplier -999%" instead of "Your Regeneration is always 0".
Illegal: Smooth Sailing
 Now also has "Demon Spawn Notification Rate +35%"
Illegal: Shield Crush
No longer has "Base damage of spells is modified by triple your Armor. Armor no longer affects damage taken."
Now has:
Your Armor amount is inverted.
Demon Armor amount is inverted.
The inverse of your Armor is also applied to Base Damage.
Illegal: Time Compression
 Now spawns 2 treasure chests per destroyed spell slot instead of 1.
Illegal: Lethargy
 Now also has "Demon Spawn Warning Duration +13%".
Arcane: Rend
 Demon Armor loss is now equal to your armor instead of double, to be more in line with current Armor values.
Arcane: Mind Expansion
 Now has "+7 Base damage per Max Mana" instead of "Damage +60%".

Spell Changes
Ground Effects
 Most burning ground now lasts half as long, but deals its damage twice as fast.
 Shocked ground now triggers its lightning bolt twice as fast.
Illegal: Eyepopper
Level 6 bonus is now " Max Rampage +7. When an Elite demon dies: Rampage Gained: +13. (Global Bonus)"
Shadow Mine & Reaper Mine
 Now triggers the oldest mine when a large amount of mines are placed, instead of deleting it.
Monsoon
 Now has "Movement Speed applied to Base Damage: +100%" instead of "Launches 2 additional balls".
 Ball Damage increased from 30% of base to 100% of base.
Overcast Sigil
 Multi-Projectile Delay increased from 0.3 to 0.4
 Secondary Projectile damage increased from 50% to 75%.
Indra's Sigil
 Multi-Projectile Delay increased from 0.3 to 0.4
 Secondary Projectile damage increased from 50% to 75%.
 Bonus per 50% Critical Chance is now +1 Pierce instead of +1 Secondary Projectile.
Magma Axis
 Base Damage increased from 15 to 20
 Knockback increased from 50 to 120
 Base Damage bonuses from levelups increased.
 Multi-Projectile Delay changed from 0.15 to 0.4
 Burning Ground from this skill is now larger and stronger
 Burning Ground spawn cooldown changed from 0.5 to 1.0
Fire of Sinai
 Base Damage increased from 15 to 30
 Knockback increased from 50 to 120
 Base Damage bonuses from levelups increased.
 Multi-Projectile Delay increased from 0.15 to 0.4
 Burning Ground from this skill is now larger and stronger
 Burning Ground spawn cooldown changed from 0.5 to 1.0
Domination
 Applied Choker effect reduced to 13% from 20%.
Phantom Reap
 Multi-Projectile Delay increased from 0.13 to 0.25.
 Regen on hit increased from 0.13 to 0.2.
 Base Damage increased from 7 to 13.
 Regen speed increased from 1.3s to 0.7s.
 Base Damage bonuses from levelups increased.
Organ Harvest
 Multi-Projectile Delay increased from 0.13 to 0.25.
 Regen on hit increased from 0.13 to 0.2.
 Regen speed increased from 1.3s to 0.7s.
 Base Damage increased from 7 to 13.
Madame Death
 Multi-Projectile Delay increased from 0.13 to 0.25.
 Regen on hit increased from 0.13 to 0.2.
 Base Damage increased from 7 to 13.
 Regen speed increased from 1.3s to 0.7s.
 Base Damage bonuses from levelups increased.

notes.title: Improvements to Charms, and Corrupted & Smuggler's Shrines! [July 12 Update]
notes.notes:
July 12 Update
Charms

 Charm chests now let you choose between 2 charms, instead of giving you a random one.
 Charms now drop more often, and the drop rate difference between the 3 maps is now less severe.

Gamble Changes
Gambling at the Smuggler Shrine no longer gives a chance to gain Astral Flowers. It now always drops a random kind of reward, and between 7 and 13 recovery orbs. It no longer costs Astral Flowers.

Possible Rewards:

 Upgrade Chest
 Demon Chest
 Charm Chest
 7 Flower Chest
 Spawn this wave's Elites again (Drops items, works with +Elite Amount)

The "Illegal Spell Multiplier +15%" effect of Sly's Smuggle passive has been changed to "The Smuggler's Gamble option is replaced with the option to gain Illegal Spell Multiplier +30%." (still drops resource orbs as well)

Corrupted Shrines

There are now 5 different types of Corrupted Shrines:


 Spell Slinger: Fires projectiles at the player.
 Chilling: Reduces how fast you can move (does not affect actual stats).
 Recovery Jammer: Reduced HP / Shield / Mana Recovery (does not affect actual stats).
 Horde: Greatly increases Demon Spawn Rate.
 Ambush: All demons spawn from spawn warnings. 

Other Changes and Fixes

 The default dash distance on enemies has been reduced by 20%.
 Hellhound's Stasis effect is now +77% Move Speed instead of +77% Move Speed Multiplier.
 Reduced the player's maximum controllable movement speed (does not affect stats)
 Fixed an issue where some descriptions that were displaying localization tags instead of text.
 Fixed an issue where Bounty Hunter's mutation was showing the description of Acrobatics' mutation.
 Added a keyword tooltip for Dodge.

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements, and Buffs! [July 11 Update]
notes.notes:
July 11 Update

Quality of Life Improvements
 Global bonuses from spells are now shown in gold to make them easier to notice. NOTE: Global bonuses are kept for the rest of the run, even if the spell is replaced or lost.
 You can now access the Demon Summoning menu from the Compendium, including during a run (but you can't modify demons during a run).
 Tooltips now work in menus, and some missing tooltips have been added.
 Keyword tooltips have been added for Recovery Orb, Demon Summoning, Demonic Choker, Global Bonus, and Extra Stat.
 There is now a compendium section for Keywords.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/2d4e74bf6562174190fe1f9f357cffce9bd971fa.png

Spell Changes
 Illegal spells now gain 1 bonus level when learned. NOTE: Remember that you always keep Global Bonuses. When Illegal spells are auto-levelled on learning them, it includes their level 6 Global Bonuses. This means you can get them more than once by switching an illegal spell back and forth, or build up a variety of bonuses by transforming across many diferrent spells.
 Meltdown's armor reduction aura boosted from -2 to -7.
 Meltdown's level effect now grants a global bonus of -7 Armor to demons within your Light Radius, instead of setting the armor reduction aura to -13.
 Throne of Darkness level 6 bonus changed from "Demons in Spell Area are Slowed" to "Effect against demons in your Light Radius: Movement speed -13 (Global Bonus)".
 Blood Spark now grants "Recovery Orb Drop Rate +25% (Global Bonus)" at level 6.
 Toxic Blizzard now grants "Illegal Spell Damage Multiplier +25% (Global Bonus)" at level 6.
 Shrinkage now grants "Damage Reduction applied to Freeze Duration: +50% (Global Bonus)" at level 6
 Indra's Sigil now gains 1 secondary projectile per 50% Crit instead of per 100%.
 Thunderswarm's Base Damage per Chain increased from 3 to 5.
 Thunderswarm's Global Base Damage per Projectile at level 10 increased from +1 to +2.


Other Changes and fixes
 Strong Hellhounds (the ones that dash) are now slowed more when Frozen. The description of Freeze has been changed to be more accurate to how it actually works (it is a slow that can hit 100%, not a binary can/can't move).
 Fixed a crash and performance hit caused by too many treasure chests being onscreen at once.
 Pickup Range and Knockback have had their positions corrected on the stat display


New achievements for the recent added content  will be coming in a future update!

notes.title: New Spell and Improvements! [July 10 Update]
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has been trying out the Hell Slayers bundle with the amazing game Halls of Torment!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32604/Hell_Slayers/

New Spell: Volt Surge
Pierce demons with an electric wave. Calls a mighty Lightning Bolt whenever it chains or finishes travelling, dealing 200% damage.

Evolution: Arc Rift
Evolved Volt Surge. Creates shocked areas that slow demons and reduce their Armor by -3. Shocked areas trigger Lightning Bolts when they expire.
Level 10: All shrines also grant: Damage +5%


Spell Changes:
- Chaos Orb and Dimension Bringer have had their base damage increased, and travel speed reduced.
- Chaos Orb and Dimension Bringer now change their direction to match your aiming direction when they teleport after going offscreen.
- Dimension Bringer now periodically Freezes all demons inside of it.
- Fixed an issue where Dimension Bringer's inner orb had a much smaller hitbox than intended.

Other Changes:
- Shrines are now less common, but twice as strong. (This is why Critical Mix was changed to 50%)
- The Oblivion modifiers that slow down Banishing and Rerolling have been changed to -30% exp loss per point instead of -40%.
- A new song by Valeriy Baryshev has been created for the game. It plays second in the combat playlist. More original music will be coming in the future!

notes.title: The OBLIVION Update is HERE! [New Features]
notes.notes:
Today's update brings a HUGE amount of new features and improvements - There's a lot to cover with this one, so let's just jump right into it!

New Spellbook - Vella

Vella
"I'll eat you alive!"
Unlock Requirement: Finish a run with 4 copies of the same spell at level 10 or above.

Starting Spell: Domination
Carves up nearby demons. Elites that have been hit with Domination are summoned on death, boosting your power. 20% of Choker effects apply to demons summoned this way. Evolves into Apex Predator.

Starting Bonus: Orb Recovery Effect +20%, Damage Multiplier vs Elites +7%
(See Health & Mana Orbs section further in the update)

Passive 1: Berserk - You deal 1.5x damage. Max Spell Limit -2.
Passive 2: Madness - When Elite demons are spawned, spawn an additional one.

The final spellbook Enigma will be coming in the next update, along with a bunch of new spells!

Demon Summoning
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/9f0968d746ddd950d26f351fa8df29294d0b8866.gif
Summon demons, trapping them inside of a Shrine to massively boost your power!
[olist]
Upgrades > Unlock "Corruption"
Win a run with at least 7 Corruption to unlock Demon Summoning!
Reaching 46 Corruption will get you 7 demons at a time. You don't need to maintain a Corruption level to keep the unlocked Demon slots
Find Red Demon Chests to unlock more Demons
Mainly drops during overtime
Level up demons to increase passive stats and summon duration
Level up demons using Astral Flowers, or by summoning them if you successfully finish a run.
Find Demonic Equipment
Equipment such as Demonic Chokers can be equipped into demon slots.
Find Overdrive Chips to limit break demons beyond level 100![/olist]
Drop rates are higher in the main game than they were in Beta.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/c17243f7a65302145689dd3cfaf6ee66f39cba92.gif
Corruption Difficulty Scaling
[olist]
Complete a game with Max Corruption to increase the Corruption limit
Each Corruption grants enemies +1% Damage, +2% Protection, -1% Knockback
Each Corruption level also increases the Score Multiplier by 5%.
Corruption increases the Demon Chest drop rate
[/olist]
Oblivion Modifiers and Charms
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/a54dafa51745a760da5db4a5153698c2ce443415.gif

 Oblivion difficulty options are unlocked after surviving for 20 minutes with 77 Malice
 This is a new set of advanced difficulty options that massively increases the available challenge.
 Increasing Oblivion allows higher rarity Charms to drop. You can equip 3 Charms.
 To get Voidslayer rarity charms, you need to stack Malice and Oblivion.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/eea11e3347ccaece23849bb3ba9475320cff9818.png

Dashing Enemies

Certain enemies will now dash towards you to close the gap. The overall difficulty of enemy projectiles has been toned down to make room for more types of enemy behavior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/b752435feeed0730f2b9dd0dad1400c9bdde1116.png

The "Hasted" elite modifier has been renamed to "Drifter", and now also allows the buffed elite demon to dash at you. Demons can shoot you while they're dashing, so make sure you watch out for dangerous combinations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/596714c4bce5c1e5027643f8d7deb3a4258df6cc.png

Enemy Spawn Notifications

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/c6facaa48cf7267e2b7903b0d89be7f88cf8ad53.png

Enemies can now also spawn directly onto the map, instead of only from offscreen. A quick warning will show you where enemies are going to appear.

Increasing your Light Radius will make demons spawn further away from you.

Health & Mana Orb Drops

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/727c3bed69723e9ed7aaf24e35cd0bbb238e0f67.png

Stronger enemies now drop orbs that refill your Health and Mana! This recovery is instant and is not considered Regeneration.

Spellbook Passive Buffs

Most spellbooks have been buffed in ways that allow them to scale further into endgame, or reach it more reliably.

Tammy
ːsteamthisː Passive 1: Adds a +7% Critical Multiplier bonus onto every Shrine, which improves with Buff Effect. Particularly good with String of Ears!
ːsteamthisː Passive 2: Now also adds a 13% chance to get 3 upgrades from treasure chests. There is also a summonable demon that allows you to spawn treasure chests, working nicely with this effect.

Speare
ːsteamthisː Speare is stronger than you'd think on first glance, but is missing a bit of juice and early game. Her starter bonus has been upgraded to also have Spell Projectile Amount +1.

Wolfe
ːsteamthisː Passive 2: Now also reduces Aura Evolution level requirement by 25%.

Jeane
ːsteamthisː Passive 1: Now grants a 7% HP bonus per revive instead of flat +7 HP.
ːsteamthisː Passive 2: Now also adds a 50% chance to duplicate buffs stolen from Elites.

Astrid
ːsteamthisː Passive 1: This passive gives +3% damage for each Astral Flower gained. This has been indirectly buffed because you gain Astral Flowers at a much faster pace in this update.

Berry
ːsteamthisː Passive 1: Chance to remain at the same level on levelup increased from 10% to 13%.
ːsteamthisː Passive 2: Buff effect per collected treasure chest increased from 2% to 3%. It is also now possible to spawn more treasure chests than before due to Demon Summoning.

Sly
ːsteamthisː Passive 1: Now also converts 50% of Movement Speed into Critical Chance.

Eden
ːsteamthisː Starter Spell: Fixed a bug where Shadow Mine and Reaper Mine were not being affected by any damage bonuses.


Level 10 Spell Effects

Spells now grant additional global bonuses at level 10, giving you more ways to scale your build.

Overload
4% Of energy shield added as base damage. (All Spells)
Grants +7 Energy Shield at level 7 and 8

Spectre Shot
Projectile Pierce Amount +1 (All Spells)

Prime Bolt
Spell Projectile Amount +1 (All Spells)

Cataclysm Sigil
Chance to Duplicate Elite Buffs +13%

Nova Cleave
Energy Shield +7
Energy Shield +13%

Winter Sigil

notes.title: Beta UPDATE！Summon Demons, Collect Memory Fragments, and Take Oblivion Challenge
notes.notes:
Hi! I've been working on getting everything ready for the beta as fast as possible. After being tested, this content (and more) will move to the main branch!

To join the Beta in Steam, right-click the game in the library page and select "Properties". Among the available tabs will be the "BETAS" tab.
The beta should be listed in the dropdown menu under "Select the beta you would like to opt into"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/4fe932009a07f7b6178ba136636619f50de503d2.png

Corruption, Demons, and Oblivion — New Mechanics and Lore!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/03ff6ae0592bc0733ccee82a6abbaca2abe3beca.png

🆕New Corruption difficulty system: An endlessly scaling difficulty climb that allows you to uncover Memory Fragments, and learn the art of Demon Summoning.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/4af4847adf20ff536cf12259ca17f1584b862c62.png

🆕Memory Fragments Part 1: Learn more about the world, characters, and lore of Spellbook Demonslayers! The first portion of this system is available for Beta.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/f1d27912f1b73860507c000eb2c2f023f9fe25cc.png

🆕Demon Summoning: Equip a selection of demons to grant you passive bonuses during battle. Demons can also be Summoned into Stasis, temporarily suspending them inside a Shrine to grant you an extreme burst of power based on the chosen demon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/9b208ab127653e508637dbc0698ce799cba00960.png

Demons level up when summoned into Stasis, but only if you win! You can also boost their level by spending Astral Flowers, to a max of Level 100.
By clearing increasing amounts of Corruption, you will earn the ability to equip up to 7 Demons at a time!


🆕New Treasure: Find treasure chests that contain Demon Essence to unlock new summons! These are mostly found during overtime.

🆕Demon Limit Break: When all demons have been unlocked, increase their level caps beyond 100 by finding additional Demon Essences.

🆕Demonic Equipment: In addition to essences, you can also find Demonic Chokers! These powerful pieces of equipment will grant additional effects to Stasis for ALL of your demons. Combine demons and equipment to create game-breaking summon combos!

🆕New Oblivion difficulty modifiers: Trade away the memories of your own power in exchange for the ability to find powerful new equipment called Charms. (Charms will be coming later in beta, but the Oblivion mods are available right away!)

🆕New Music: Some new music is being worked on by Val, you can hear early pre-mix versions of them in the beta!

Valeriy Baryshev - Charming (Charms) (UNFINISHED)
Valeriy Baryshev - Coral Sunset (Victory) (UNFINISHED)
Valeriy Baryshev - Crimson Dawn (Difficult Victory) (UNFINISHED)
Valeriy Baryshev - Trailblazer (Upgrades)

Accompanying artists:
Scott Arc - PRANA
TeknoAXE - Walking it Back

🆕New Score Formula: Increase your score to ridiculous amounts with Oblivion and Corruption!

Previously, playing on 77 Malice would result in the highest possible score multiplier of about 1.4x. In the new system, playing on 77 Malice will result in a multiplier of 2.0x.

Adding 25 Oblivion onto that will result in a 27.0x multiplier.
Stacking Corruption onto that will scale it even further, by 5% per Corruption.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682201/9f8ede20fca1d23c9c20c6f972f2825d67694970.png

- Enemy wave balance has been significantly changed.
- A variety of interfaces have been improved visually and functionally.
- Enemy blood can now be disabled.
- A sound now plays whenever you refill Mana.
- The sound that plays when you take damage is now much louder.
- Negative Armor amounts on enemies now is calculated at the same step as Base Damage, allowing it to interact with your damage boosts.
- Time Compression can no longer generate more than 1 Corrupted Shrine. This effect was created before you could level spells beyond 10, and was became overpowered when uncapped spells were added.
- Spell Damage Multiplier per level on uncapped spells reduced from 10% to 9% to bring few-spell and many-spell builds closer in power.
- Various bugfixes

Planned later in Beta
🆕New Charms system will arrive to the game in 7-10 days.
Equip Charms to boost yourself with powerful effects. Playing with more Oblivion modifiers increases the power level of Charms that you can find, and allows you to unlock more Charm slots.

Planned for the next update
Vella and Enigma will join the game with the new update, that is in ~20 days.

notes.title: Important Update on Spellbook Demonslayers Development
notes.notes:
Dear players,
 
First of all, we want to express our deepest gratitude for your ongoing support and passion for the game. Indeed, it has been quite some time since the last update, and we sincerely apologize for the delay in bringing new content and improvements to the game.
 
We want to be transparent with you all and share the reason behind the lack of updates in recent months. Unfortunately, Xendra, the solo-dev behind the Spellbook Demonslayers, close family member has been facing a dire health issues that demanded their immediate attention. As a result, the game development was slowed considerably.
 
Developer is working as hard as they could to prepare the next major update. In the coming weeks, we will be sharing more information about what you can expect from the new versions. We want to thank you for your understanding, patience, and continued support during this challenging time for the developer.
 
Once again, we apologize for the delays and any inconvenience this may have caused. We are confident that the upcoming update will be worth the wait and that Spellbook Demonslayers will continue to provide an entertaining and immersive experience for all of our players.
 
Stay tuned for more news and updates, and as always, happy demon-slaying! And tell us what you are expecting for future updates in a steam review, thank you! We can't be here WITHOUT you!
 
Erabit Team

● The upgrade interface now has multiple tabs to separate different types of upgrades.

● Juggernaut's evolution "Heavy Lifting" now grants 5% of Max HP Added as Base Damage, up from 3%.

● Regen Breaker: Applies -7% Regeneration Multiplier on hit for 4s.
New Shrines

Fixes
● Fixed an issue where the "Damage per Pierced Enemy" damage bonus was not updating frequently enough.
● Fixed an issue where fractional enemy damage was being rounded incorrectly. This fix stops Eden's passive "Mercy" from reducing damage to less than 1, but you can still achieve huge tankiness by dropping your HP as close to 1 as you can.
● Fixed an issue where the illegal upgrade "Black Hole" was not adding base damage to damaging areas like rotating shields.
● Fixed an issue where Aura Evolution information would stay open even when not hovering.
● Fixed a memory leak related to the character selection screen.
● Fixed an issue where Revengeance's evolution "Bloodstream" was not multiplying the damage bonus from Thickening's aura "Adapatation".

notes.title: Optimizations & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where Smoke Barrage would not appear in the Smuggler's Shop.

- Fixed an issue where progression costs would sometimes begin to scale much higher than intended.

- Fixed an issue where existing elite enemies would gain extra Damage Reduction if they were alive when Endless mode loops. This damage reduction was only meant to apply to the elites that spawn in the new loop.

- Optimized the amount of calculations needed to determine how much damage an enemy will take when hit.

- Optimized the amount of calculations needed to determine how much damage a projectile or damaging area will deal.

- Optimized the amount of calculations needed to determine whether an enemy with knockback resistance will be knocked back.

- Fixed an issue where Inferno's knockback was lower than intended.

- Fixed an issue where lightning bolts from some sources had 0 Knockback.

- Fixed an issue where some skills would report incorrect damage values.

- Fixed an issue with text spacing when using an Asian language.

- Your equipped passive is now shown at the end of the run stats screen.

- Reduced the rate of HP scaling on elite enemies during overtime.
